status: assignment-actor recording and client resolution foundation implemented; assigned-by saved filters remain unfinished
contract: Server-owned read-only table follows current tasks SELECT policy and root generation; inactive child tombstones are not readable.
Actual authenticated actor recorded on initial assignment or assignee transition. Same-recipient retries, title/date/completion edits and child reparenting preserve the assignment event.
Child removal/reappearance with the same stable identity and recipient preserves provenance for Undo; explicit unassignment/reassignment creates a new event.
Malformed, duplicate, missing-ID, excessive-depth or excessive-size legacy checklists never acquire invented identities or block unrelated changes through this new trigger.
Unassignment hides current provenance; account deletion nulls actors/recipients through FKs. Deleting a root cascades its metadata; restored root incarnations cannot use old history.
Recognized recurrence successors remain unknown; client source_metadata and recurrence_parent_id are not trusted attestations of a previous actor.

Imports/copies with fresh root identities record their creator as the initial Taskfold assignment actor, not an external historical assigner. Portable exports omit this server-only catalog; files containing it cannot certify history.
Client model binds recipient, root identity/generation and case-sensitive nested path. Missing, malformed, ambiguous, stale and unavailable catalogs cannot produce a confirmed actor.
Store commit, Snapshot.apply and Backend.send refuse generic client mutations of the provenance table.
